description: This file defines the ContactFormBase class, a PHP class extending PersonFormBase, providing form rendering and handling logic for Contact entities in SuiteCRM, including duplicate detection, form generation, and save handling.

classes.name: ContactFormBase
classes.description: A PHP class for managing contact form display and processing in SuiteCRM, including duplicate detection, form rendering, and save logic.

methods.name: getDuplicateQuery
methods.description: Constructs and returns an SQL query string to check for duplicate contacts based on first and last name, considering optional record exclusion.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Generates HTML form markup for a wide contact form, including address, contact details, email, and custom fields.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Generates HTML form markup for a basic contact form, used in create/edit views.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Builds the complete HTML form for creating or editing a contact, including headers and submit button.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submission to save contact data, handle duplicates, inbound emails, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Redirects to the appropriate view after save, based on return module/action and other parameters.

methods.name: getContact
methods.description: Returns a new Contact bean instance.
